name: qa-process
description: Test process and strategy: risk-based testing, test strategies, Definition of Done, smoke gates, test pyramid balance, effort estimates and post-mortems. Also covers E2E suite budgets, test ideas from stories and live features, framework choice, and attack-surface checklists. Agents (release-readiness-checker, quality-coach, release-engineer) run multi-gate go / no-go checks, audit work against the Definition of Done, and walk a release runbook with human gates.
